falsifiable_hypothesis: The public assay workbook includes standard negative DMSO and positive BzCl controls on both plates. The verified B predictor already uses only 64 selected treatment wells, but its remaining mean residual may still track plate dynamic range. A two-feature calibrator using only the two standard-control dynamic ranges can capture assay-quality drift while leaving the treatment acquisition contract unchanged.
base_prediction_rule: Reproduce paid_cardinality_separate_local_pooling from the same two_dose_full_negative_A_extension base. Do not stack the comparator prediction itself.
standard_control_feature_rule: From the authenticated public workbook, for each Lib1 sample and each plate separately, select compound_type control_negative and control_positive. The observed negative control is DMSO and positive control is BzCl. Compute range_p = log1p(max(median(raw_signal_negative)-median(raw_signal_positive),0)). Use exactly [p1_range,p2_range]. No treatment response outside the already selected 64 treatment wells is added.
residual_target_rule: Within each outer-training partition, first cross-fit the verified global mean/std/min/max common model and min/max cardinality-contrast model across the authenticated K=3 whole-patient inner folds. Then cross-fit the verified shared/two-dose/three-dose local models on those upstream residuals, including the fixed 2*PRIOR=0.25 local strength. The control calibrator target is the mean across 24 targets of the twice-cross-fitted leftover B residual for each training sample.
control_calibration_rule: Fit one patient-balanced affine ridge regression of the scalar leftover residual on the two standard-control dynamic-range features. Center the two features by their patient-balanced fitting means. Let G=Z^T W Z and scale=trace(G)/2. Use lambda=PRIOR*scale with frozen PRIOR=0.125. Fit beta=(G+lambda I)^-1 Z^T W(r-rbar). At prediction time add the resulting scalar correction equally to all 24 B targets. Orientation A is unchanged.
budget_statement: This family adds zero treatment wells and leaves the 64-treatment-well, 32/32 plate plan unchanged. It does require the standard DMSO/BzCl plate-control observations already present in the source assay. Those controls are reported explicitly rather than counted as treatment wells.
regularization_rationale: The basis is fixed to only the two control dynamic ranges, and ridge strength is the inherited PRIOR times the mean fitting-feature energy. No feature menu, lambda grid, target routing, fold rescue, protected data, or outer-held fitting enters canonical replay. The family remains repeated adaptive development because preceding outer outcomes were inspected.

task_contract.ab_rule: average losses across separately costed A/B orientations; never average predictions
